decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - No new plumbing, pipes, soilstacks, flues, vents or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved.
Condition : 3 - 3	No new grilles, security alarms, lighting, cameras or other appurtenances shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved.

Condition : 4 - 4	All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric, shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.

Condition : 5 - 5	Details in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council as Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the relevant work is begun.  The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with such approved details:
i.	Detailed drawings at no less that 1:10 of junctions between the new pitched rood and the existing flat roof, and of the ridge to the new pitched roof
ii.	Technical literature for the proposed new roof lights
iii.	Samples of the slates to be used in the new roof
description: Replacement of existing glass roof with slate roof incorporating conservation roof lights to building
